# af-proto (generated, do not edit)

Rust (prost) types for the Affogato contracts in `proto/affogato/*/v1`.

`src/` is generated by `buf generate` (plugins `neoeinstein-prost` and `neoeinstein-prost-crate`,
pinned in `buf.gen.yaml`). Do not edit it by hand: change the `.proto` files and regenerate with

```sh
make contracts-gen
```

`Cargo.toml` is the only hand-maintained file; keep `prost`/`prost-types` at the version the
pinned plugin generates for. `bytes` fields are `bytes::Bytes`.

```rust
use af_proto::affogato::events::v1::VideoChunkUploaded;
```
